panels.title: Ledger Build Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often the node constructs a new ledger from its parent, applying transactions and writing state.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should match the consensus close cadence.
**Healthy range:** About 0.25/s on mainnet (~4s rounds).
**Watch for:** A drop below the close rate means the node is not keeping up with ledger construction.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Time to build a full ledger, including applying transactions, writing state, and finalising acceptance.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of per-build durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Scales with transaction volume and disk I/O.
**Healthy range:** Tens to a few hundred milliseconds under typical load.
**Watch for:** Long build times indicate expensive transaction sets or I/O pressure while flushing state.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="ledger.build"}[5m])))

panels.title: Ledger Validation Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often ledgers reach the trusted-validation quorum and become fully validated.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should match the build and close rates on a healthy node.
**Healthy range:** About 0.25/s on mainnet.
**Watch for:** A shortfall means ledgers are not accumulating enough trusted validations to be accepted.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp:LedgerMaster::checkAccept

panels.title: Ledger Build Duration Heatmap
panels.description:
**What:** Distribution of ledger-build durations over time, revealing spread beyond a single percentile.
**How it's computed:** Counts of builds by duration band in each 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** A tight band at low durations is healthy; brighter cells mark the common build time.
**Healthy range:** Concentrated in the low tens of milliseconds.
**Watch for:** An occasional high-duration band flags slow builds that percentile charts may miss.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl

panels.title: Transaction Apply Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Time to apply the agreed transaction set into the new ledger, including retry passes.
**How it's computed:** 95th and 50th percentile of per-ledger apply durations over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Grows with the number and complexity of transactions in the set.
**Healthy range:** Tens to a few hundred milliseconds under normal load.
**Watch for:** Sustained high durations indicate heavy or expensive transaction sets.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:applyTransactions

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m])))

histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, service_instance_id) (rate(span_duration_milliseconds_bucket{service_instance_id=~"$node", deployment_environment=~"$deployment_environment", xrpl_network_type=~"$xrpl_network_type", service_name=~"$service_name", span_name="tx.apply"}[5m])))

panels.title: Transaction Apply Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often the transaction-application phase runs during ledger building.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** One apply pass per ledger build, so it should track the build rate.
**Healthy range:** About 0.25/s on mainnet.
**Watch for:** Divergence from the build rate signals an accounting or pipeline anomaly.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:applyTransactions

panels.title: Ledger Store Rate
panels.description:
**What:** How often completed ledgers are written into the local ledger history.
**How it's computed:** Per-second rate over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Should match the build rate under normal operation.
**Healthy range:** About 0.25/s on mainnet.
**Watch for:** A store rate below the build rate means ledgers are being built but not persisted.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/LedgerMaster.cpp:LedgerMaster::storeLedger

panels.title: Build vs Close Duration
panels.description:
**What:** Ledger construction time versus total ledger-close time; construction is a subset of close.
**How it's computed:** 95th percentile of each duration over a 5-minute window, per node.
**Reading it:** Build should sit at or just below close.
**Healthy range:** Both a few hundred milliseconds or less, tracking each other.
**Watch for:** A large gap means significant overhead in the consensus pipeline outside ledger construction.
**Source:** src/xrpld/app/ledger/detail/BuildLedger.cpp:buildLedgerImpl, src/xrpld/app/consensus/RCLConsensus.cpp:RCLConsensus::Adaptor::onClose
